title: Malicious code in @kingsaurus/libsignal-node (npm)
description: The npm package @kingsaurus/libsignal-node contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of the malicious software, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
